provision.title: Provision a gateway
provision.offline: You need signal to get an activation code
provision.scanHint: Scan the QR on the gateway's label or type its serial; you get a single-use activation code.
provision.assigned: Gateways of this building waiting to be provisioned
provision.expires: Valid until {date}, once. A new code replaces this one.

instructions.power: Connect the gateway's power and LAN cable (or Wi-Fi)
instructions.page: Join the same Wi-Fi with this phone and open the gateway's status page
instructions.enter: Enter the code above in the activation box of the status page

provision.ipLabel: The gateway's LAN IP (from the router or the label)
provision.waitingTitle: Waiting for the gateway to come online
provision.slowHint: Not online yet: check the power, the LAN cable and that the full code was entered. The code stays valid until it expires.

install.title: Install a smart meter
install.offline: You need signal to install. What you entered is kept; try again when you have signal.
install.deviceHint: Scan the QR or barcode on the meter; a device from the building's stock fills in its model and driver.
install.pointsUnavailable: Meter points cannot be listed yet: the API does not publish them to the staff app.
install.noFreePoints: Every meter point of this building already has a device
install.noGateway: No gateway of this building is online yet; provision one first
install.readingHint: Photograph the register and type it at install: it becomes the smart meter's first reading.
install.guide: Keep the register digits inside the frame

wiring.addressHint: 1 to 247, as set on the meter

error.busId: Use letters, digits, - or _ for the bus name
error.litresPerPulse: Litres per pulse must be 1 to 1000

identify.offline: You need signal to send a command

swap.title: Replace a meter
swap.offline: You need signal to record the replacement
swap.pointsUnavailable: Meters cannot be listed yet: the API does not publish them to the staff app.
swap.oldHint: Photograph and type the last register of the old meter of {meter} before removing it
swap.guide: Keep the register digits inside the frame
swap.doneBody: {meter} is counted on the new meter from now on; nothing to read again

detail.ipHint: Join the gateway's Wi-Fi, then type its IP from the router or the label
detail.noChannels: No meter is connected to this device yet

orders.title: Install orders
orders.progress: {open, plural, =0 {Every item done} one {# of {total} items still to install} other {# of {total} items still to install}}
